column1: # Curated corrections to the upstream readings and meanings.
# Characters take their pinyin and translation from makemeahanzi (dictionary.txt)
# and HSK 1 words from scripts/data/hsk1-vocabulary.txt. Both are wrong in places
# that decide grading: the reading card accepts ONLY `pinyin`, and the meaning
# card accepts ANY one comma/semicolon alternative of `translation`, which is also
# the writing card's prompt. See docs/data-audit.md for how each row was found.
# An empty field keeps the upstream value. seed-dictionary.ts and
# seed-hsk1-deck.ts apply this file on insert; scripts/backfill-overrides.ts
# applies it to a live database, only where the row still holds the upstream
# value, so an admin's later edit survives.
#   hsk1-sense       an HSK 1 word whose translation missed or buried the HSK 1 sense
#   deck-part-sense  a part in the HSK 1 deck (it is quizzed too) with the same problem
#   reading          the stored reading is not the standard one (erhua, neutral tone,
#                    a reading that belongs to another sense)
#   surname          a stray "surname" alternative on a character whose everyday use is
#                    something else, which let "surname" pass as an answer
#   rwc-dictionary   a character from Reading and Writing Chinese (the 2,338 a learner is
#                    likeliest to meet) whose meaning or reading the audit flagged; the
#                    fix was proposed and independently confirmed by two model passes and
#   <a>+reading      a sense fix and a reading fix on the same row
